milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate close to the birch fence gate (placed at spawn-relative [0, 0, 8] on the south face of the garden enclosure) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located and identified the gate. max_distance=5 ensures the player has walked to the garden area, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the gate rather than passing by accidentally.
